summary.text: Julie McCabe (listed on Ballotpedia as Julia McCabe) is a Democratic state representative and high school teacher who has represented Maine House District 93 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: McCabe earned a bachelor's degree from Bates College in 2012 and a graduate degree from Johns Hopkins University in 2020 (spelled "John Hopkins" on Ballotpedia).
Her career experience includes working as a high school teacher.
McCabe assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Margaret Craven, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
